Smart geometry checks · automatic

Coincident vertices, small seams and inconsistent winding are repaired when their topology can be checked. Missing surfaces and intersecting solids require source-model repair.

Radial Sectioning
Diametral fins about the chosen Fin axis + rings stacked along it, half-lap notched (Autodesk-Slicer style). Pick the model's revolution axis — the demo torus revolves about Y. Best on vases, domes, shades & bodies of revolution. Resize in Section / Transform; CNC settings shared (Section tab).
